description: Supplement of the interface-sizes vocabulary: the size keys the paper-electronics and paper-fastening standard parts need (LEDs, the CR2032 coin cell, a brad, an eyelet, round elastic cord, a 6 × 2 mm disc magnet) and the base file did not define, for the sheet commons (Pliego §5.30 paper circuits and the 'pivot' join). Same rules as the base: two interfaces mate only when their resolved size keys are EQUAL, and every dimension cites a public standard or manufacturer source. Merged into interface-sizes when the vocabulary is loaded.

review.note: Keys, labels and definitions drafted in one pass by an agent (K3 lane, 2026-10-10). No language facet has had a native review; Spanish is the bar a reviewer should read first. Facts were read from the cited sources on the access date.

label.en: 3 mm (T-1) LED body in a round hole
label.es: Cuerpo de LED de 3 mm (T-1) en un barreno redondo
label.fr: Corps de LED 3 mm (T-1) dans un trou rond
label.pt: Corpo de LED de 3 mm (T-1) num furo redondo

definition.en: The round body of a T-1 (3 mm) LED passing up through a round hole in a sheet or panel, its flange bearing on the hole's back face; and that hole. The hole's clearance is the host's design.
definition.es: El cuerpo redondo de un LED T-1 (3 mm) que atraviesa un barreno redondo de una hoja o un panel, con la pestaña apoyada en la cara posterior del barreno; y ese barreno. La holgura del barreno la decide el anfitrión.
definition.fr: Le corps rond d'une LED T-1 (3 mm) traversant un trou rond d'une feuille ou d'un panneau, sa collerette en appui sur la face arrière du trou ; et ce trou. Le jeu du trou relève de l'hôte.
definition.pt: O corpo redondo de um LED T-1 (3 mm) que atravessa um furo redondo de uma folha ou painel, com a flange apoiada na face de trás do furo; e esse furo. A folga do furo é decisão do hospedeiro.

definition.es: El cuerpo redondo de un LED T-1 3/4 (5 mm) que atraviesa un barreno redondo de una hoja o un panel, con la pestaña apoyada en la cara posterior del barreno; y ese barreno. La holgura del barreno la decide el anfitrión.
definition.fr: Le corps rond d'une LED T-1 3/4 (5 mm) traversant un trou rond d'une feuille ou d'un panneau, sa collerette en appui sur la face arrière du trou ; et ce trou. Le jeu du trou relève de l'hôte.
definition.pt: O corpo redondo de um LED T-1 3/4 (5 mm) que atravessa um furo redondo de uma folha ou painel, com a flange apoiada na face de trás do furo; e esse furo. A folga do furo é decisão do hospedeiro.

label.en: Two LED leads on a 2.54 mm pitch
label.es: Dos patas de LED a paso de 2.54 mm
label.fr: Deux pattes de LED au pas de 2,54 mm
label.pt: Dois terminais de LED com passo de 2,54 mm

definition.en: The two leads of a through-hole LED, 2.54 mm (0.1 in) apart where they leave the package, cathode and anode; and the two holes or pads that take them (a perforated board, two holes pierced in a sheet, two copper-tape pads). Not symmetric: the anode side is fixed.
definition.es: Las dos patas de un LED de inserción, a 2.54 mm (0.1 in) entre sí donde salen del encapsulado, cátodo y ánodo; y los dos barrenos o pistas que las reciben (una placa perforada, dos barrenos en una hoja, dos pistas de cinta de cobre). No es simétrico: el lado del ánodo es fijo.
definition.fr: Les deux pattes d'une LED traversante, espacées de 2,54 mm (0,1 in) à la sortie du boîtier, cathode et anode ; et les deux trous ou plages qui les reçoivent (une plaque perforée, deux trous percés dans une feuille, deux plages de ruban de cuivre). Non symétrique : le côté de l'anode est fixé.
definition.pt: Os dois terminais de um LED de inserção, a 2,54 mm (0,1 in) um do outro onde saem do encapsulamento, cátodo e ânodo; e os dois furos ou trilhas que os recebem (uma placa perfurada, dois furos numa folha, duas trilhas de fita de cobre). Não é simétrico: o lado do ânodo é fixo.

lead_pitch.note: where the leads leave the package; Vishay 2.54 nom. (sources 2 and 3); Kingbright 5 mm the same (source 1)

lead_width.note: Kingbright 0.5 square; Vishay 0.5 × 0.4 at 3 mm (source 2) and 0.5 square at 5 mm (source 3)

label.en: CR2032 cell in a holder or pocket
label.es: Pila CR2032 en un portapilas o un hueco
label.fr: Pile CR2032 dans un support ou une poche
label.pt: Pilha CR2032 num suporte ou rebaixo

definition.en: A CR2032 coin cell seated in a holder or in a pocket cut through stacked card; and that holder or pocket, sized for the cell's maximum diameter and height.
definition.es: Una pila de botón CR2032 asentada en un portapilas o en un hueco cortado en cartulinas apiladas; y ese portapilas o hueco, dimensionado para el diámetro y la altura máximos de la pila.
definition.fr: Une pile bouton CR2032 logée dans un support ou dans une poche découpée dans des cartons empilés ; et ce support ou cette poche, dimensionnés pour le diamètre et la hauteur maximaux de la pile.
definition.pt: Uma pilha-botão CR2032 assente num suporte ou num rebaixo cortado em cartões empilhados; e esse suporte ou rebaixo, dimensionado para o diâmetro e a altura máximos da pilha.

sources.title: Energizer CR2032 lithium coin product datasheet (form 2032NA0618)
sources.supports: Li/MnO2; designation ANSI/NEDA-5004LC, IEC-CR2032; nominal 3.0 V; typical 235 mAh to 2.0 V on 15 kΩ at 21 °C; typical 3.0 g; diameter 20.00 max / 19.70 min; height 3.20 max / 2.90 min; negative face Ø17.70 max; (+) on the can, (−) on the cap face; operating −30 to 60 °C

sources.title: Panasonic CR2032 CR coin-type lithium primary battery, product information (as of April 2022)
sources.supports: CR2032: nominal 3 V; nominal 225 mAh; diameter 20.0 max; height 3.2 max; approx. 2.8 g without tabs; operating −30 to +85 °C

entries.notes: Added for the sheet-parts entries (lane K3). The cell's male side is coin-cell-cr2032.rim.

definition.en: The positive face of a CR2032 cell (the flat of its can) pressing on a contact or a conductive pad. Neutral: face to face. A key of its own, so a positive pad never mates the negative face.
definition.es: La cara positiva de una pila CR2032 (el fondo plano de su carcasa) apoyada en un contacto o una pista conductora. Neutra: cara contra cara. Tiene clave propia, para que una pista positiva nunca se una a la cara negativa.
definition.fr: La face positive d'une pile CR2032 (le fond plat de son boîtier) appuyée sur un contact ou une plage conductrice. Neutre : face contre face. Une clé à part, pour qu'une plage positive ne s'accouple jamais à la face négative.
definition.pt: A face positiva de uma pilha CR2032 (o fundo plano do invólucro) apoiada num contacto ou numa trilha condutora. Neutra: face contra face. Tem chave própria, para que uma trilha positiva nunca acople à face negativa.

can_diameter_max.note: the can, which carries the positive terminal

sources.title: Energizer CR2032 lithium coin product datasheet (form 2032NA0618)
sources.supports: Li/MnO2; designation ANSI/NEDA-5004LC, IEC-CR2032; nominal 3.0 V; typical 235 mAh to 2.0 V on 15 kΩ at 21 °C; typical 3.0 g; diameter 20.00 max / 19.70 min; height 3.20 max / 2.90 min; negative face Ø17.70 max; (+) on the can, (−) on the cap face; operating −30 to 60 °C

entries.notes: Added for the sheet-parts entries (lane K3). Pliego §5.30 pin 'plus'.

definition.en: The negative face of a CR2032 cell (its smaller cap face) pressing on a contact or a conductive pad. Neutral: face to face. A key of its own, so a negative pad never mates the positive face.
definition.es: La cara negativa de una pila CR2032 (la cara de la tapa, más pequeña) apoyada en un contacto o una pista conductora. Neutra: cara contra cara. Tiene clave propia, para que una pista negativa nunca se una a la cara positiva.
definition.fr: La face négative d'une pile CR2032 (la face du couvercle, plus petite) appuyée sur un contact ou une plage conductrice. Neutre : face contre face. Une clé à part, pour qu'une plage négative ne s'accouple jamais à la face positive.
definition.pt: A face negativa de uma pilha CR2032 (a face da tampa, menor) apoiada num contacto ou numa trilha condutora. Neutra: face contra face. Tem chave própria, para que uma trilha negativa nunca acople à face positiva.

cap_face_diameter_max.note: the raised cap face, which carries the negative terminal

sources.title: Energizer CR2032 lithium coin product datasheet (form 2032NA0618)
sources.supports: Li/MnO2; designation ANSI/NEDA-5004LC, IEC-CR2032; nominal 3.0 V; typical 235 mAh to 2.0 V on 15 kΩ at 21 °C; typical 3.0 g; diameter 20.00 max / 19.70 min; height 3.20 max / 2.90 min; negative face Ø17.70 max; (+) on the can, (−) on the cap face; operating −30 to 60 °C

entries.notes: Added for the sheet-parts entries (lane K3). Pliego §5.30 pin 'minus'. A pad wider than the cap face can touch the can's edge and short the cell: keep a negative pad under 17.7 or insulate the rim.

label.es: Encuadernador a través de hojas apiladas
label.fr: Attache parisienne à travers des feuilles empilées

definition.en: The split shank of a two-prong paper fastener (brad) through a pierced or punched hole in stacked sheets, its round head on the top sheet and its prongs opened flat behind the bottom one; and that hole. The pivot of a sheet join. The hole is the host's design: no cited source gives the shank's width.
definition.es: El vástago partido de un encuadernador de dos patas a través de un barreno perforado o troquelado en hojas apiladas, con la cabeza redonda sobre la hoja superior y las patas abiertas en plano tras la inferior; y ese barreno. El pivote de una unión entre hojas. El barreno lo decide el anfitrión: ninguna fuente citada da el ancho del vástago.
definition.fr: La tige fendue d'une attache parisienne à deux pattes à travers un trou percé ou poinçonné dans des feuilles empilées, sa tête ronde sur la feuille du dessus et ses pattes rabattues à plat derrière celle du dessous ; et ce trou. Le pivot d'une liaison entre feuilles. Le trou relève de l'hôte : aucune source citée ne donne la largeur de la tige.
definition.pt: A haste fendida de um colchete de duas pernas através de um furo perfurado ou vazado em folhas empilhadas, com a cabeça redonda sobre a folha de cima e as pernas abertas por trás da de baixo; e esse furo. O pivô de uma união entre folhas. O furo é decisão do hospedeiro: nenhuma fonte citada dá a largura da haste.

head_diameter.note: 15/32 in as listed (source 1 too), × 25.4 (derived): the head that bears on the top sheet

sources.title: ACCO solid brass round head fasteners, 1-1/4 in, 100/box (71505) — retailer listing; the maker's page was not reached
sources.supports: round head fastener; length 1.25 in (1-1/4 in size); 15/32 in head diameter

sources.title: ACCO solid brass round head fasteners, 2 in, 100/box (71507) — retailer listing; the maker's page was not reached
sources.supports: round head fastener; 2 in shank; length 2.0 in; 15/32 in head diameter; self-piercing points; solid brass

entries.notes: Added for the sheet-parts entries (lane K3); the size key of Pliego's 'pivot' join made with a brad. Provisional: the shank width, and so the hole, is not cited.

label.en: Eyelet barrel in a 4/32 in hole
label.es: Cañón de ojillo en un barreno de 4/32 in
label.fr: Fût d'œillet dans un trou de 4/32 in
label.pt: Corpo de ilhós num furo de 4/32 in

definition.en: The barrel of a small eyelet (0.121 in outside, 0.125 in under the flange) through a 4/32 in (1/8 in) hole in card or stacked sheets, its flange on the top face and its rolled end behind; and that hole.
definition.es: El cañón de un ojillo pequeño (0.121 in de diámetro exterior, 0.125 in bajo la pestaña) a través de un barreno de 4/32 in (1/8 in) en cartulina u hojas apiladas, con la pestaña en la cara superior y el extremo remachado por detrás; y ese barreno.
definition.fr: Le fût d'un petit œillet (0,121 in de diamètre extérieur, 0,125 in sous la collerette) à travers un trou de 4/32 in (1/8 in) dans du carton ou des feuilles empilées, sa collerette sur la face du dessus et son extrémité rabattue derrière ; et ce trou.
definition.pt: O corpo de um ilhós pequeno (0,121 in de diâmetro exterior, 0,125 in sob a aba) através de um furo de 4/32 in (1/8 in) em cartão ou folhas empilhadas, com a aba na face de cima e a ponta rebatida por trás; e esse furo.

sources.title: Stimpson GS 4-4 brass eyelets (SKU X-GS44B), maker's web store
sources.supports: brass; flange diameter 0.2 in; outside (barrel) diameter 0.121 in; length under flange 0.125 in; length overall 0.152 in; hole size 0.097 in; metal thickness 0.009 in; fits a 4/32 in hole

entries.notes: Added for the sheet-parts entries (lane K3). The eyelet's male side is eyelet-gs-4-4.barrel; also a size key for Pliego's 'pivot' join made with an eyelet.

label.en: Elastic cord end through a hole
label.es: Extremo de cordón elástico por un barreno
label.fr: Extrémité de cordon élastique dans un trou
label.pt: Ponta de cordão elástico por um furo

definition.en: An end of a round elastic cord (about 1 to 1.5 mm across) threaded through a hole in a sheet and knotted or glued behind it; and that hole. The hole is sized by the host for the chosen cord.
definition.es: Un extremo de cordón elástico redondo (de entre 1 y 1.5 mm de grosor) que pasa por un barreno de una hoja y se anuda o se pega por detrás; y ese barreno. El anfitrión dimensiona el barreno para el cordón elegido.
definition.fr: Une extrémité de cordon élastique rond (d'environ 1 à 1,5 mm de diamètre) passée dans un trou d'une feuille et nouée ou collée derrière ; et ce trou. L'hôte dimensionne le trou pour le cordon choisi.
definition.pt: Uma ponta de cordão elástico roliço (com cerca de 1 a 1,5 mm de diâmetro) passada por um furo de uma folha e atada ou colada por trás; e esse furo. O hospedeiro dimensiona o furo para o cordão escolhido.

sources.title: Prym elastic cord, 1.5 mm, gold-coloured, 3 m (article 971069)
sources.supports: Ø 1.5 mm × 3 m; 80 % elastodiene, 20 % metallized thread

sources.title: Beadalon Elasticity 1.0 mm clear elastic cord, 25 m (SKU STR-CLR-128) — retailer listing
sources.supports: string size 0.039 in (1.0 mm); spool 82 ft (25 m); elastic; clear

entries.notes: Added for the sheet-parts entries (lane K3). Provisional: the key does not carry the cord's diameter, so a hole sized for 1.5 mm mates a 1.0 mm cord too; a per-diameter key is the alternative if mates must check it.

label.en: 6 × 2 mm disc magnet in a pocket
label.es: Imán de disco de 6 × 2 mm en un hueco
label.fr: Aimant disque 6 × 2 mm dans une poche
label.pt: Ímã de disco 6 × 2 mm num rebaixo

definition.en: A 6 mm × 2 mm disc magnet seated in a round pocket cut into card or board (or a printed recess); and that pocket. The clearance is the host's design.
definition.es: Un imán de disco de 6 mm × 2 mm asentado en un hueco redondo cortado en cartulina o cartón (o en un rebaje impreso); y ese hueco. La holgura la decide el anfitrión.
definition.fr: Un aimant disque de 6 mm × 2 mm logé dans une poche ronde découpée dans du carton (ou un logement imprimé) ; et cette poche. Le jeu relève de l'hôte.
definition.pt: Um ímã de disco de 6 mm × 2 mm assente num rebaixo redondo cortado em cartão (ou num alojamento impresso); e esse rebaixo. A folga é decisão do hospedeiro.

sources.title: Disc magnet Ø 6 mm, height 2 mm, neodymium, N45, nickel-plated (S-06-02-N)
sources.supports: diameter 6 mm; height 2 mm; tolerance ±0.1 mm; NdFeB, grade N45; Ni-Cu-Ni plating; magnetised axially (parallel to the height); strength approx. 740 g (approx. 7.26 N); displacement force approx. 150 g (1.46 N); max. working temperature 80 °C; weight 0.43 g

entries.notes: Added for the sheet-parts entries (lane K3). The magnet's male side is magnet-disc-6x2.body.

label.es: Cara polar de imán de disco de 6 mm
label.fr: Face polaire d'aimant disque de 6 mm
label.pt: Face polar de ímã de disco de 6 mm

definition.en: A flat pole face of a 6 mm axially magnetised disc magnet meeting another magnet's face or a steel striker face to face. Neutral. Which pole is which, and so whether two faces attract, is not part of the key.
definition.es: Una cara polar plana de un imán de disco de 6 mm magnetizado axialmente que se encuentra cara contra cara con la de otro imán o con una placa de acero. Neutra. Qué polo es cada cara, y por tanto si dos caras se atraen, no forma parte de la clave.
definition.fr: Une face polaire plane d'un aimant disque de 6 mm aimanté axialement rencontrant face contre face celle d'un autre aimant ou une contre-pièce en acier. Neutre. Quel pôle est quelle face, et donc si deux faces s'attirent, ne fait pas partie de la clé.
definition.pt: Uma face polar plana de um ímã de disco de 6 mm magnetizado axialmente que encontra face contra face a de outro ímã ou uma peça de aço. Neutra. Qual polo é cada face, e portanto se duas faces se atraem, não faz parte da chave.

sources.title: Disc magnet Ø 6 mm, height 2 mm, neodymium, N45, nickel-plated (S-06-02-N)
sources.supports: diameter 6 mm; height 2 mm; tolerance ±0.1 mm; NdFeB, grade N45; Ni-Cu-Ni plating; magnetised axially (parallel to the height); strength approx. 740 g (approx. 7.26 N); displacement force approx. 150 g (1.46 N); max. working temperature 80 °C; weight 0.43 g

entries.notes: Added for the sheet-parts entries (lane K3). Polarity of the poles is not modelled; an assembly that needs attraction must say which faces face which.
